# ADR-3246: AWS s3: Documented public website bucket for static site 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Static websites are intentionally public.

## Decision

Web teams MAY adopt a documented public website bucket for static site 6 (AWS-s3-6) when hosting public static assets.

## Consequences

CloudFront and OAC are preferred fronts.
